faq.q: Is the Sunseeker Predator 74 available for charter in Marbella?
faq.a: We don't operate a Sunseeker Predator 74 in our fleet. Our closest comparable is the Mangusta 80, a 24m open sport yacht that carries 12 guests and departs from Puerto Banús. If you're set on a Predator, you'd need to look at third-party brokers, but we recommend the Mangusta for better value and capacity.

faq.q: How much does it cost to charter the Mangusta 80 in Marbella?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. This includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. A jet ski is also included free of charge, making it a strong deal for groups.

faq.q: Which boat is faster: Mangusta 80 or Sunseeker Predator 74?
faq.a: Both boats are performance-oriented. The Mangusta 80 has a top speed of around 40 knots, while the Sunseeker Predator 74 typically reaches about 38-40 knots depending on engines. In practice, you'll feel similar speed, but the Mangusta's larger hull offers more stability at cruise.

faq.q: How many guests can the Mangusta 80 carry?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 is certified for 12 passengers plus crew. This makes it ideal for larger groups, birthday celebrations, or corporate events. The Sunseeker Predator 74 typically carries 8-10 guests, so you'd have to split groups or choose a bigger boat.

faq.q: What's included in the Mangusta 80 charter price?
faq.a: Every Mangusta 80 charter includes a professional skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). A jet ski is also included free of charge for the duration of your charter.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks on the Mangusta 80?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. However, our standard package already includes a selection of beverages and light snacks. If you have specific catering needs, we can arrange a gourmet menu on request — just let us know when booking.

faq.q: Where does the Mangusta 80 depart from in Marbella?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 departs from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury marina. You'll meet the crew at the dock, board, and set off towards the coast. Popular routes include Cabopino, Cala del Faro, and even Estepona, depending on sea conditions and your preference.

faq.q: Is the Mangusta 80 suitable for a wedding or proposal?
faq.a: Absolutely. With space for 12 guests, a flybridge, and a large aft deck, the Mangusta 80 is perfect for intimate weddings, proposals, or anniversaries. The crew can help arrange flowers, decorations, and a photographer. The included cava adds a celebratory touch as you cruise along the Marbella coast.

data.body_html:
If you're weighing up a Mangusta 80 vs Sunseeker Predator 74 for a Marbella charter, you're looking at two serious performance yachts. But here's the thing: we operate the Mangusta 80, not the Predator 74. And after comparing specs, capacity, and value, we think the Mangusta 80 is the smarter choice for most groups. Here's why.

Mangusta 80 vs Sunseeker Predator 74: Key Specs Compared

Both boats are built for speed and style, but they differ in size and layout. The Mangusta 80 measures 24 metres in length, while the Sunseeker Predator 74 is slightly shorter at 22.5 metres. That extra 1.5 metres translates into more deck space and a higher passenger capacity — 12 guests vs the Predator's typical 8-10.

Deck Space and Comfort: More Room for 12 Guests

The Mangusta 80's open layout is designed for socialising. The aft deck has a large U-shaped sofa and a dining table that seats 12 comfortably. The flybridge adds another lounging area with sunpads — perfect for soaking up the Marbella sun. In contrast, the Predator 74's cockpit is sportier but tighter; you'll feel the squeeze with a full group. If you're planning a day out with friends or family, the Mangusta 80 wins on sheer space.

Performance and Handling: Both Quick, One More Stable

Top speeds are similar — around 40 knots for the Mangusta and 38-40 for the Predator. But the Mangusta's longer hull and deeper V-entry give it better stability at cruising speeds, especially when the Mediterranean chop picks up. You'll enjoy a smoother ride from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Cala del Faro, without sacrificing that thrill of speed.

Charter Cost and Inclusions: The Mangusta 80's Clear Advantage

Our Mangusta 80 is available for a minimum of 4 hours at €4,719. That price includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. Plus, you get a jet ski included free. For a Sunseeker Predator 74, you'd have to go through a broker, and prices typically start higher — often €5,000+ for 4 hours, without the extras. The Mangusta 80 delivers more value per euro.

Interior and Amenities: Practical Luxury

Below deck, the Mangusta 80 offers three guest cabins (a master, a VIP, and a twin) plus crew quarters. The interior is modern with light woods and neutral tones, creating a bright, airy feel. The Predator 74 also has three cabins, but the overall volume is less. For a day charter, you'll spend most time on deck, but if you want to overnight or use the cabins for changing, the Mangusta gives you more breathing room.

Where You'll Cruise: Marbella's Best Spots

Departing from Puerto Banús, the Mangusta 80 can whisk you to Marbella's top anchorages. Head east to Cabopino for shallow turquoise waters, or west to Cala del Faro near Estepona for a quieter swim stop. The crew knows the coast intimately — from the Golden Mile to Sotogrande — and will tailor the route to your wishes. With the jet ski onboard, you can explore hidden coves that larger yachts can't reach.

Why Choose the Mangusta 80 Over a Sunseeker Predator 74?

If you're comparing Mangusta 80 vs Sunseeker Predator 74, the choice comes down to value and capacity. The Mangusta 80 carries more guests, offers more deck space, and comes with a transparent, all-inclusive price. You won't find hidden extras — the jet ski is included, the drinks flow, and the crew handles everything. For a group of up to 12, it's the practical winner.

Book Your Mangusta 80 Charter in Marbella

Ready to experience the Mangusta 80 for yourself? Check our boat rental Marbella hub for more options, or WhatsApp us for availability and custom itineraries. We'll confirm your slot in minutes and have you cruising from Puerto Banús in no time.
